title: Settlement & Custody
description: Institutional custody and settlement services, supported by technology that brings greater visibility to positions, balances and transactions.

unlinked.title: The buy settles first
unlinked.body: Cash leaves your account to pay for the securities.

unlinked.title: The sell fails to settle
unlinked.body: The sale proceeds are delayed, leaving your cash tied up.

unlinked.title: You fund the gap
unlinked.body: You may need financing and pay interest until the sell settles.

linked.title: The buy is held
linked.body: Payment for the buy waits while the sell is pending.

linked.title: The sell is ready
linked.body: Both instructions are ready to settle together.

linked.title: Both trades settle together
linked.body: The sale proceeds arrive when payment for the buy is due.

storySummary.unlinked: You pay for the buy before the sale proceeds arrive.
storySummary.linked: The sale proceeds are available when the buy settles.

questionnaire.title: How does your current set-up measure up.
questionnaire.description: Six questions. Three areas to examine: cost, complexity and exposure.
questionnaire.notice: This questionnaire is an informational discussion aid. It is not a quotation, assessment of suitability, commitment to provide a service or guarantee of savings. Actual fees and service availability depend on client, instrument, account structure and applicable arrangements.

crossBorderArchive.body: In a shared omnibus account, securities bought for one client can be used to meet another client’s delivery. For larger clients, we can open dedicated Euroclear accounts so your securities stay identified as yours.

serviceSections.lead: International securities may need to move between different depositories. Securities belonging to different clients should not cross between unrelated settlement obligations.

panels.title: Shared omnibus account
panels.body: A pooled account can create cross-client settlement and allocation risk.

panels.title: Dedicated client accounts
panels.body: Separate account structures keep each client’s securities separately identifiable.

serviceSections.lead: When your buy settles but your corresponding sell fails to settle, you can be left financing the position and paying interest while you wait.

panels.title: Without linked trades
panels.body: The buy settles, but the sell fails to settle. You may have to finance the position and pay interest while you wait.

panels.title: With linked trades
panels.body: The buy is held until the sell is ready. Both trades then settle together, avoiding the need to finance a position while waiting for the sell.

serviceSections.lead: A Bloomberg VCON confirmation can carry the trade details already agreed between counterparties. Re-keying those details creates avoidable work and opportunities for input errors.

overview.title: Nothing left in the dark.
overview.lead: The trade is only one part of the transaction.
overview.body: Cash movements, securities positions and outstanding trades all need to be accounted for. Our post-trade infrastructure connects settlement activity with account information, providing a clearer picture of what has happened and what remains outstanding.

custody.title: Custody is a responsibility not a feature.
custody.lead: Holding client money and securities comes with specific obligations.
custody.body: Our UK custody and safeguarding arrangements operate within the FCA's Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS).

rules.title: Client Money
paragraphs: Client money held or controlled by EMFI Capital Limited is subject to applicable segregation requirements. These include appropriate records, reconciliations and arrangements with the banks holding client money.
The statutory trust framework is designed to protect client money in the event of a firm's failure.

rules.title: Safe Custody Assets
paragraphs: Safe custody assets are subject to separate requirements governing their safekeeping, records and reconciliations.
These rules are designed to protect clients' ownership rights and help distinguish client assets from those belonging to the firm or other clients.

custody.callout: Segregation, accurate records, reconciliations and oversight are fundamental to the way custody arrangements operate.
